context_files.purpose: Exact v6 architecture proposal under independent systems review.
Adjudicated v5 blockers and required successor repairs.
Normative prose resolution of the v5 systems blockers.
Bound causal and semantic contract, including fresh-from-birth mutation invariance.
Exact proposed capability, producer, lifetime, bridge, denial, and release topology.
Exact proposed G0-G4 first-action prerequisite DAG.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal preserves the three-organ learner boundary: THINK owns continuing child cognition and action, DREAM is disposable waking context, and SLEEP is a closed-world re-expression and fresh-from-immutable-birth rewrite of already child-authored grounded life. The one-time T/D schooling intervention, fixed/adaptive parent controllers, capability machinery, preservation evaluator, auditors, and release controller are laboratory infrastructure rather than new cognitive organs. This interpretation finds the intended thesis coherent, but the exact systems bytes do not yet fully realize their own least-authority, atomic-CAS, producer-closure, and noncircular-test claims.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph correctly removes active-weight dereference from E4 candidate construction, confines prior active weights to waking/DREAM/exam use and the postconstruction E5 preservation comparison, splits candidate preservation from scientific evaluation, separates executor/scorer/reporter, quarantines detailed audit findings, and registers a complete nine-field opaque-release tuple. Its 42 artifact classes, 90 capabilities, and 57 close/reissue bridges mechanically form a complete per-consumer handle graph. Three structural gaps remain: E4 support resolution has no capability for its frozen authorship/grounding/threshold contract; candidate-root equality, verdict, and full-head CAS are not coupled to the active-head write by one registered atomic operation; and audit/authority execution is absent from the action DAG even though those producers are mandatory on the release path.
loop_delta_interpretation: The intended order is sound: build candidate bytes from immutable birth, fresh zero-effective-delta adapter, cumulative eligible life, frozen writer contract, and seed; close those bytes; only then stage and evaluate; finally promote or quarantine under a full-head CAS. However E4_COMPILER_BIND_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT is issued to the same E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER invocation as the construction capabilities, so the registry does not enforce the asserted post-closure phase boundary. A stale or mutated head can therefore affect an observable bind result within the writer invocation unless construction and staging are separate principals or the bind handle is issued only after candidate seal. At promotion, BIND_EQUALITY followed by WRITE is a check-then-write sequence, not an atomic compare-and-swap as registered. Split scientific evaluation is otherwise directionally correct: executor has model plus public input, scorer has closed transcript plus truth, and reporter has score records only, with no return edge.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claims are appropriately conditional and narrower than generic experiential-learning, parenting, repetition, or mediation claims. Systems evidence could support only reproducibility, isolation, lineage, and noninterference; it cannot establish Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, replay benefit, cadence benefit, extraction, native use, or safety. No proposal, interpretation, audit, preservation verdict, or passing fixture supplies execution, GPU, scientific-claim, publication, push, or release authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix has the exact 29-by-90 Cartesian shape (2,610 unique cells), and mechanical comparison found every visible cell equal to the capability's sole allowed consumer and every other cell forbidden. E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER has no ACTIVE_WEIGHT_ARTIFACT capability, and all READ, DEREFERENCE, BIND_EQUALITY, ADVANCE, and TRANSFER_OPAQUE handles have exactly one matching close/reissue bridge. Artifact persistence is separated from one-consumer, one-invocation handle lifetime, and constant-shape denial collapses stale, copied, replayed, wrong-root, wrong-operation, and wrong-consumer failures. These are strong static properties, but constant-shape behavior is not executable until the deferred fixed widths and padded deadline are bound, and matrix correctness cannot compensate for the missing support-contract input or the unatomic promotion primitive.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The 21 tests cover the right scientific and systems hazards, but the required_before labels are not yet executable as a noncircular gate. ES03 runs the real writer, ES05 reconstructs real births, ES06 and ES20 exercise real lineage/CAS faults, ES08 requires produced audit objects, and ES12 exercises the parent lifecycle, yet all are marked required before implementation. ES19 and ES21 can begin as G0 static/fake-fixture tests, but their exact G0 receipts are not mapped to the other test IDs. Each test must be mapped to a concrete DAG action and prerequisite receipt, with model-free fixture variants separated from post-implementation dynamic variants. Constant-shape tests must wait for a separately frozen byte-width/deadline contract, while every real writer, tokenizer, model, data, GPU, scientific, claim, and release test must remain behind its own authority and earlier cheap evidence.
assumptions: The registry defaults normatively supply capability version 1, G0_CAPABILITY_ISSUER, ONE_CONSUMER_ONE_INVOCATION_V1, and CONSTANT_SHAPE_DENIAL_V1 to every capability entry.

Artifact payload schemas, wire widths, authentication, serializer, fsync, retry, quarantine, cache, and evaluation bytes remain intentionally deferred and grant no ambient operation before their separately authorized contracts are frozen.

The visibility matrix is generated solely from v6_capability_registry.json; the mechanical product and consumer-equivalence checks are evidence about proposal consistency only, not implementation evidence.
No action listed in the prerequisite DAG is presently authorized; G0 also requires a new exact human authorization.

ambiguities.question: What distinct work is performed by A_G2_11_RUN_PERSONAL_SLEEP_WRITER versus A_G2_12_COMPILE_CANDIDATE when the registry assigns compilation and candidate writing to one E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER principal?
ambiguities.impact: Without exact phase outputs and capabilities, the two actions can duplicate work, allow an unregistered intermediate adapter, or place CAS before candidate closure.

ambiguities.question: Is RELEASE_TARGET_ARTIFACT a sealed wrapper whose payload binds the tuple's concrete artifact_class, or must the transfer capability itself be specialized per concrete releasable artifact class?
ambiguities.impact: The exact rule is needed to prevent a generic wrapper from weakening artifact-class equality in the otherwise complete release tuple.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The producer graph is not closed for the E4 evidence-support decision.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal requires a frozen grounding rule, evidence threshold, child-authorship rule, and disagreement behavior, and the action DAG freezes them in R_REPLAY_SUPPORT_AND_WRITER_CONTRACT_FROZEN. Yet E4_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_RESOLVER can read only CHILD_GROUNDED_TRACE and PUBLIC_OBSERVATION. No artifact class, source, capability, or bridge supplies the frozen resolver contract, so an implementation must use ambient configuration or cannot implement eligibility.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a content-addressed FROZEN_SUPPORT_RESOLVER_CONTRACT produced by X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE, a per-invocation E4 support-resolver READ capability and close/reissue bridge, update the matrix/counts/hashes, and bind its root in eligibility and taint receipts.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The registry does not enforce that committed-snapshot equality is observed only after candidate bytes close.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: E4_COMPILER_BIND_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT is available to the same E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER invocation that constructs C_s. Although prose orders the bind after closure, the capability graph permits an early bind or branch, so prior-head mutation can change construction control flow and violate the scientific core's byte-and-trace mutation invariance.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split pure candidate construction from staging into distinct principals/epochs, give the constructor no CAS capability, and issue the equality-only staging handle only from the sealed candidate transition; test that head mutation changes at most the later staging outcome, never candidate bytes or construction trace.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The registered E5 promotion path cannot by itself implement the claimed atomic full-head compare-and-swap.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: E5_GATE_BIND_COMMITTED_CAS performs equality and E5_GATE_WRITE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT later performs a generic WRITE whose request contains only a new artifact root and namespace. Another promotion may change the head between those operations; no registered operation atomically binds expected full-head token, candidate root, verdict root, and replacement head.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Register one atomic promotion-CAS operation, or redefine one store-mediated operation whose request equality-binds expected full-head root/token, candidate root, verdict root, and new active root and whose single transaction emits the promotion receipt. Deny stale/retry paths without any separate unconditional WRITE.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The action DAG is topologically acyclic but is not producer-closed for the release path.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The registry requires static dependency/dispatcher manifests, E7 blindness and lineage attestations, an E8 authority verdict, and a release receipt. The 40-action DAG has no execution actions that seal the real manifests, run either auditor, or run the authority verifier. A_G4_04_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE depends on external release authority and implementation receipts but not on receipts for the mandatory attestations or authority verdict.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add separately gated actions and produced receipts for real manifest sealing, blindness audit, lineage audit, authority verification, and opaque transfer. Make each consume the exact predecessor artifact roots and make release depend on the tuple-bound authority-verdict receipt; recompute ranks, first-action classes, lowest GPU/release sequences, and tests.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT is too weak to be the trust root for an exact fail-closed gate.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Its required bindings name action, allowed paths, forbidden scope, nonce, and expiry, but do not bind the registry root, action-DAG root, validator/gate implementation roots, or expected G0 output manifest. Different or permissive gate bytes could therefore satisfy the same authorization envelope.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind the exact v6 registry and DAG roots plus each authorized G0 implementation/input manifest root in R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT, and require installed-gate receipts to echo those roots.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Several dynamic tests are still required before the implementation they need in order to execute.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: ES03, ES05, ES06, ES08, ES12, and ES20 require real writer, birth, lineage, auditor, or parent machinery but are labeled required_before implementation. The action DAG correctly distinguishes G0 fake/static validation from G1/G2 domain work, but the acceptance registry does not map tests to that ordering, recreating the v5 self-gate at the test layer.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep only explicitly model-free schema/static/fake-fixture variants before G1, then map every dynamic test to the earliest implemented action it validates and require its receipt before the next dependent execution action. Update required_before from broad phase strings to exact action or receipt IDs.

open_questions: Will the exact v6 proposal be revised and freshly deliberated to close the resolver-contract, postclosure-CAS, atomic-promotion, audit-action, G0-binding, and acceptance-ordering defects before any ratification?
Will G0 remain a separately exact, model-free authorization bound to the precise registry, DAG, validator, bridge, gate, and fixture roots, with every domain action still separately unauthorized?

Will implementation, model/tokenizer/data execution, adapter/checkpoint work, GPU/resource use, external science, claims, publication, push, release, and intake transition remain forbidden pending their own exact human scopes?
